content: Rust output determinism: std HashMap/HashSet use RandomState seeded per process, so iteration order differs run to run on the same binary and machine; any iteration that reaches serialised bytes is a determinism bug. BTreeMap/BTreeSet/Vec are ordered. Integer arithmetic and IEEE-754 +,-,*,/,sqrt are bit-reproducible across targets; float formatting via Display/format! is a deterministic algorithm in core. Transcendentals (sin, cos, exp, ln, powf, powi via libm) dispatch to the platform libm and DO differ between glibc, musl, macOS and MSVC; the libm crate gives one implementation everywhere. sort_unstable does not preserve the relative order of equal keys, so sorting by a key that is not unique can reorder payloads. Detection: run the same encode twice in one process, and compare artefact hashes across the target matrix in CI.
